title: SaaS Landing Page
palette_note: Pure-black base with one acid lime-yellow used only on icons, the balance card gradient and the chart bar; every other hue is borrowed from the desaturated grass photography.

type.note: Hero switches mid-sentence from a wide grotesque into a high-contrast italic display serif ('financial life'); ~90px hero over ~15px body, tiny pill eyebrows at ~11px, and running body copy that fades from white to mid-grey as emphasis.

imagery: blurred macro nature photography with product screenshots composited on top

layout.note: Centred hero over a full-bleed photo, then a hard switch to a left-aligned editorial paragraph and a three-up stat row split by hairline verticals; second panel is a card grid where photo tiles show through frosted overlays.

style_signature: Full-bleed blurred nature macro behind a centred grotesque headline that breaks mid-line into italic display serif, all on pure black, with a single acid lime-yellow reserved for icons and data marks.

title: Schedulo — Online Booking Request in SaaS Booking App
palette_note: Neutral-cool whites with one cyan-teal ramp carrying all the data; the mint AI strip is the only saturated block, and the whole app floats on a warm grey #D0D0D0 presentation canvas.

type.note: Rounded geometric with a large semibold greeting (~30px) against 13px UI text; sidebar groups labelled in 10px tracked ALL-CAPS grey; KPI numerals set very large and light with tiny tinted delta pills beside them.

imagery: iconography only, plus circular avatar photos

layout.note: Fixed icon+label rail against a fluid card grid; ~14px card radius with generous internal padding; a heatmap grid of tinted cells is used as much for texture as for data.

style_signature: White hairline cards floating on a warm grey studio canvas, a single cyan-teal value ramp doing all the data work, and a full-width mint-tinted AI suggestion strip as the only saturated surface.

title: Imagica clean SAAS design tool
palette_note: Completely achromatic — a narrow band of mid-greys with zero brand hue; white is used as the accent, appearing only in the Login pill and the lit face of the sphere.

type.note: One hero line alternates Light and Bold weights word by word ('A new way to think and create'); eyebrow is 13px ALL-CAPS with wide tracking; nav is uniform 14px regular with no hierarchy.

layout.note: Single centred axis running through the sphere; enormous vertical air above and below the headline; the CTA sits inside the render rather than beside it, and the nav runs edge to edge.

style_signature: A matte 3D sphere resting in rippling greyscale liquid carries the entire page — no colour whatsoever, a weight-alternating neo-grotesque headline, and a hairline pill CTA floated on top of the render itself.

title: Convox SaaS - Call Center Dashboard
palette_note: Desaturated cool greys with a faint green cast; a single pale chartreuse does every highlight — buttons, sparkline strokes, gauge tips, bar fills — and no second hue appears anywhere.

type.note: Rounded geometric; metric numerals set enormous and light (2.270, 00:07) with unit suffixes dropped to small grey subscripts, while all labels sit at a flat 13px.

imagery: product screenshot rendered onto a 3D monitor, plus cut-out portrait photography inside the hero card

layout.note: Card separation is done entirely with tinted fills and whitespace — not a single stroke; a 3-up metric row sits over a 2-column split, and the icon rail is a stack of detached rounded squares.

style_signature: Borderless pale-grey card fills with no strokes at all, oversized light-weight numerals, one pale chartreuse handling every highlight, presented as a soft-focus 3D monitor render in a grey studio.

title: Aqara Mobile App - Smart Home SaaS
palette_note: Near-black chrome over a desaturated slate-blue studio backdrop; one saturated electric blue tile and one lemon-yellow confirmation dot are the only chroma in the whole frame.

type.note: Two-line 'Work Room' hero at large size with very tight leading; sensor readouts pair a bold figure with a small lowercase unit set on the baseline (12 dB, 400 lx); all chip labels a uniform small weight.

imagery: 3D product render of the phone on a concrete plinth, with interior photography showing through the app

layout.note: Overlapping squircle tiles deliberately collide and break the grid; day chips fan out on a diagonal; the tab bar is a chain of interlocking circles rather than a bar.

style_signature: Blurred-glass squircle tiles overlapping each other above a dimmed room photo, near-black chrome punctured by one electric blue block, staged as a tilted phone floating off a concrete plinth in slate-blue studio light.

title: Convox SaaS - Call Center Solution
palette_note: A single top-to-bottom chartreuse-into-cool-grey gradient is the entire background; controls are frosted tints of it, so the screen has effectively one hue at varying saturation.

type.note: Labels and headings set in an oblique/italic cut of the geometric sans — the italic is the identity move; two-line name heading at ~34px against 12px grey metadata and small-caps-feeling timecodes.

imagery: cut-out portrait photography dissolving into the gradient, on a 3D-rendered phone held in hand

layout.note: Single scroll column with huge breathing room; playback controls are a row of detached frosted squares; the timeline ruler with tick labels is the only linework on screen.

style_signature: A chartreuse-to-grey vertical gradient used as the whole background, cut-out portraiture bleeding into it with no edge, borderless frosted control squares, and an oblique geometric sans for every label.

title: Farm Management SaaS Dashboard
palette_note: Neutral grey chassis deliberately drained so the imagery carries all colour; status uses a hot acid lime, and every quantitative element is a green-to-red heat ramp rather than a brand hue.

type.note: Enormous scale jump — 'My Farm' at ~64px light against 11px labels; big numerals (28, 500, 850, 45.4) dominate every tile while their captions shrink to near-illegible grey.

imagery: aerial drone photography plus close-up produce photography inside tiles

layout.note: Translucent grey bento tiles layered over a full-bleed aerial photo panel that owns the right half; icon-only left rail; no strokes anywhere, only frosted fills against imagery.

style_signature: Translucent grey frosted bento tiles floating over full-bleed drone photography, green-to-red heat ramps used as the entire data language, and hot acid-lime chips as the only flat colour.

title: AI SaaS Web Platform
palette_note: No brand hue at all — the palette is sampled straight out of the render: warm sand and umber concrete with one olive green from the grass; all type is white knocked out of the image.

type.note: Three-line centred hero whose middle line swaps to a high-contrast italic didone ('Redefine space'); nav 14px regular inside a glass pill; a three-line 13px paragraph anchored bottom-left as a caption.

imagery: 3D renders (brutalist concrete interior with grass growing through it)

layout.note: One full-bleed rounded hero card inset from an off-white page with equal margins on all sides; content pinned to the four corners of that frame with the centre reserved for the headline; outline pill tags bottom-right.

style_signature: A single rounded full-bleed 3D render of warm concrete and grass becomes the whole page, its own sand-and-umber tones taken as the palette, with a grotesque headline interrupted by one line of high-contrast italic serif.

title: Contextual delete confirmation for SaaS
palette_note: Effectively achromatic — near-white ground, black ink, grey secondary text; the only chroma in the frame lives inside two glossy app-icon thumbnails.

type.note: Bold ~28px section title beside a light-grey one-line description; prices use an inline two-tone weight trick — bold black figure, grey regular unit ('$40 /blog post').

layout.note: Two stacked full-width rows plus a dashed-outline 'add' slot, isolated with acres of margin on every side; row actions reduced to two outline glyphs at the far right; a drawn mouse cursor is the only prop.

style_signature: A single UI fragment isolated on pure white with enormous margins, hairline rounded rows, a dashed-outline add slot as the empty state, and a rendered cursor as the only storytelling device.

title: Constellation - AI SaaS Startup Platform Landing Page Website
palette_note: Near-black with a cold indigo cast; saturation arrives only as glow — a bruise-coloured indigo-to-violet bloom from the crystal and footer — with tiny pale-lime dots as the one warm signal.

type.note: Headlines stay at regular weight and never bold, ~40px over 12px 60%-grey body; nav and eyebrows in small tracked ALL-CAPS; the footer wordmark is blown up until it bleeds off both edges.

imagery: 3D renders (faceted iridescent crystal) plus product screenshots and floating notification cards

layout.note: Sections are hairline-bordered rectangles butted directly against each other with no gutters — a continuous framed grid; a scrolling logo marquee cuts across; three-up pricing with the middle plan lifted by a lighter fill.

style_signature: Hairline-bordered black panels butted edge to edge with zero gutters, lit only by an indigo-to-violet glow bleeding out of a faceted crystal render, tiny lime bullet dots, and a wordmark scaled until it runs off the page.

title: Case Study for Squadhub - Saas Team Management Website
palette_note: High-key white and pure black doing all the work, with acid lime as the single loud signal and one periwinkle card as a deliberate off-note; the ghosted wordmark is barely-there #F0F0F0.

type.note: Ultra-bold display grotesque set huge with very tight tracking and negative leading, punctuation kept in (apostrophes, exclamation mark) as part of the voice; avatar stack inlined mid-headline; small 14px pill labels as the only other type size.

imagery: product screenshots rendered on a display, plus avatar photography

layout.note: Composition cropped hard so the monitor bleeds off two edges; thin right-angle connector lines with dot terminals tether floating UI fragments back to the copy; a heavy left-aligned type block owns the empty half.

style_signature: Black ultra-bold grotesque set huge and tight on white, punched with acid-lime pill chips and one periwinkle card, laid over a ghosted oversized wordmark with hairline right-angle connector lines linking cropped UI fragments.

title: DataGrid Table Filters for Saas Dashboards and web apps
palette_note: Cool near-white throughout with a single saturated blue reserved for selection, checkboxes and link actions; mint and rose tints appear only as trend pills — colour is strictly semantic, never decorative.

type.note: One size, one weight across the whole grid — hierarchy comes only from grey column headers against near-black cell values; numerals tabular; field labels above the filter columns in small grey regular.

layout.note: A real six-column grid with full-bleed hairline row rules and alternating selected-row tint; a modal and a floating date picker stack over the live table with layered soft shadows; L-shaped indent brackets express nested condition groups.

style_signature: Full-bleed hairline-ruled data grid in cool near-white, one saturated blue for selection and links, mint/rose semantic pills, and layered soft-shadow modals floated directly over the still-visible table.

title: KirriDesk - AI Reply Draft Suggestion in SaaS CSM
palette_note: Neutral whites and greys with a single emerald doing the primary action, the active tab and the status dots; a pale mint fill ring-fences AI-generated content as its own colour category.

type.note: Uniform 14–15px body with medium-weight names; sidebar sections labelled in 10px tracked ALL-CAPS grey; machine-translated lines set smaller and lighter beneath the original, separated by dashed rules.

imagery: iconography only, plus initial-based avatar chips

layout.note: Real Safari chrome wraps the app; three zones — nav rail, thread column, right icon strip; the AI draft is a tinted card nested inside a white card, with its own header, feedback controls and footer toolbar.

style_signature: A real browser chrome wrapping a three-column support desk, emerald as the single accent, and AI output quarantined inside a nested mint-tinted card carrying its own header, thinking-time label and thumbs controls.

title: DevTools — Flow Details (Node) in SaaS API Testing
palette_note: Cool near-white with a faint blue cast; colour is used purely as syntax — per-verb tinted chips (green GET, amber POST, red DEL, blue PUT) — plus one violet for the single destructive-ish action, Run.

type.note: Everything sits at 13–14px regular with almost no scale variation; the only display gesture is the HTTP verbs in tiny bold ALL-CAPS on tinted grounds; URLs run inline in the same face rather than a mono.

layout.note: Rounded floating app window on a light grey canvas with a near-black top bar; a dotted-grid node canvas with orthogonal elbow connectors sits above a params table, and a floating black toolbar pill hovers over the graph.

style_signature: Colour deployed strictly as syntax — tiny tinted HTTP-verb chips and one violet Run button — over a dotted-grid node canvas of hairline cards, with a floating black toolbar pill and a near-black workspace bar as the only heavy values.

title: Notification center for dashboard saas real estate web app ui/ux
palette_note: White panels on a pale blue-grey canvas; a sky blue marks selection and role-change links while a teal marks the second role — colour is used as inline semantics inside running sentences, not as branding.

type.note: Inter-like grotesque at a single body size; emphasis is done inline by switching weight and colour mid-sentence ('role was changed from Lead to Buyer'), with bold near-black for old state and coloured medium for new.

imagery: iconography only, plus avatar photos and one glossy 3D-styled section icon

layout.note: Master/detail split — a bordered list panel with hairline row dividers beside a scrolling grouped feed; the selected row takes a pale blue fill plus a blue left-edge marker; counts sit in grey pill badges right-aligned.

style_signature: Master/detail white panels with hairline borders on a pale blue-grey canvas, a selected row marked by pale blue fill plus a blue left-edge bar, grey pill counters, and running sentences where state words switch to blue and teal.
